# A drone, 0.84 m across: a dark octagonal body, two crossed arms, four teal rotor discs and a glowing eye at the front (-Y). Pivot at the body's centre.
# Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Dark --base-color 0.224 0.165 0.110 --no-slot
material new Steel --base-color 0.573 0.494 0.416 --no-slot
material new Rotor --base-color 0.235 0.624 0.612 --no-slot
material new Glow --base-color 0.937 0.227 0.047 --no-slot --emission 0.937 0.227 0.047
add mesh cylinder --name Body --vertices 8 --radius 0.18 --depth 0.13 --location 0 0 0
material assign Dark
add mesh cone --name Dome --vertices 8 --radius1 0.13 --radius2 0.05 --depth 0.08 --location 0 0 0.1
material assign Steel
add mesh cube --name Arm1 --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.000
scale 0.950 0.080 0.060
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 45
apply --rotation
select Arm1
material assign Dark
add mesh cube --name Arm2 --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.000
scale 0.950 0.080 0.060
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 -45
apply --rotation
select Arm2
material assign Dark
add mesh cylinder --name Rot3 --vertices 10 --radius 0.17 --depth 0.04 --location -0.335 -0.335 0.05
material assign Rotor
add mesh cylinder --name Rot4 --vertices 10 --radius 0.17 --depth 0.04 --location -0.335 0.335 0.05
material assign Rotor
add mesh cylinder --name Rot5 --vertices 10 --radius 0.17 --depth 0.04 --location 0.335 -0.335 0.05
material assign Rotor
add mesh cylinder --name Rot6 --vertices 10 --radius 0.17 --depth 0.04 --location 0.335 0.335 0.05
material assign Rotor
add mesh cube --name Eye7 --size 1 --location 0.000 -0.190 0.010
scale 0.120 0.070 0.070
apply --scale
select Eye7
material assign Glow
select all
shade flat
export drone.glb
